text: Good evening please, I am a foster carer and the little boy staying with me is 2 years old. His temperature is 39 now and I am really afraid, he only came to us few weeks ago and I don't know his body well yet. I checked him well well for any rash, there is nothing at all on his skin, I even did the glass thing to be sure. My question is how much paracetamol or ibuprofen I can give him? I don't want to give wrong dose abeg. Which one is better for this temperature, or can I give both? Please help me, I am not able to sleep at all
